description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2096/17 of 05.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (President Maithripala Sirisena) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities for the Minister of Mahaweli Development & Environment, including specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, public corporations, and laws/ordinances to be implemented. The content includes both "who" (the President making the assignment) and "what" (detailed ministerial responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
